method: Reviewed the complete lesson against current Anthropic strict tool use / tool definition docs and the OWASP authorization guidance. Ran the Python 3.14.7 offline verifier, which compiles all seven Python fences, executes the two demos, and checks malformed-ID preflight, scheduling barriers, result matching, unknown outcomes, validator behavior and text boundaries. No provider or external network calls. Isolated production build generated 399 pages; Pagefind indexed 399 pages / 15,393 words. Light/dark full-page screenshots were visually inspected at 1300px; document width=1300px, article width=792px, Mermaid rendered, and browser console errors=0.

checks: duplicate, missing, empty and non-object tool_use IDs fail before dispatch side effects
mixed serial/parallel scheduling preserves serial barriers and request-order result association
tool_result content serialization and unknown-tool error signaling are exercised
unknown or timed-out side-effect outcomes pause for reconciliation rather than normal model continuation
JSON boolean does not match numeric enum values, including nested array values
strict tool-use documentation is scoped to enabled supported schemas; authorization and business checks remain host responsibilities
historical provider behavior and production authorization are explicitly unverified
isolated production build and Pagefind pass; light/dark full-page screenshots show centered article, no horizontal overflow, and rendered Mermaid

limitations: The scheduler and registry examples use local synthetic functions; no provider, live model, external service, real authorization engine, cancellation, or distributed scheduler was exercised.
Anthropic strict tool use documentation was reviewed, but no API request verified a current model, endpoint, setting, or schema subset in this environment.
The 2026-10-12 0.81 second timing remains a historical single-run sleep-script observation; the serial comparison is arithmetic, not a measured control.
Historical model ratios and endpoint outcomes remain unavailable for independent replay; this review does not confirm them.
